customer_name: Shenyang Intelligent Computing Center (沈阳智能计算中心)
business_problem: Shenyang needed a shared AI and digital-infrastructure foundation that could support regional digital-government goals and help local industries adopt compute, large models, and AI services without every organization building isolated capabilities on its own.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Shenyang's local development authorities built the region's intelligent computing center as a public AI foundation rather than a single application system. The program combines one industrial park, four centers, and multiple downstream scenarios so the city can support infrastructure, innovation, talent development, and industrial enablement from one coordinated base. At the technical layer, the solution brings together the data center, AI equipment, BaiGe heterogeneous compute capabilities, and the Qianfan large-model platform into an end-to-end stack. Those resources back an AI center cluster and feed the innovation, talent, and enablement centers that package the infrastructure into usable public services. In practice, the center gives Shenyang a common AI substrate for sectors such as the metaverse, industrial internet, cultural tourism, biomedicine, and aerospace, while also helping attract ecosystem partners into the regional digital economy.
products_used: Shenyang Intelligent Computing Center Public Service Platform

solution_components.name: BaiGe Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared heterogeneous AI compute capacity used by the center's regional workloads.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the large-model tooling and service capabilities that sit on top of the center's AI infrastructure.

solution_components.name: Shenyang Intelligent Computing Center Public Service Platform
solution_components.role: Packages the center's infrastructure into a regional public-service layer for industrial enablement, innovation, and talent programs.

data_flow: Regional industry and public-service workloads enter the intelligent computing center, where shared data-center and AI-equipment resources are scheduled through BaiGe. Qianfan then supports large-model development and service delivery, and the resulting capabilities are exposed through the center's innovation, talent, and enablement programs to downstream sector applications.
business_outcome: Shenyang established a reusable public AI base that can support regional industrial transformation, attract ecosystem partners, and accelerate adoption of large-model services across multiple strategic sectors.
